description: For a sequence of subsets \(A_n\) of the naturals, \(b_0\) is the infimum of \(A_0\), and \(b_{n+1}\) is the infimum of points larger than \(b_n\) lying in all \(A_i\) with \(i\) at most \(n+1\). Under the strong finite intersection hypothesis, these infima are the required least admissible points.
